scientific_choices.rationale: Construct a new one-output attention U-Net with random decoder/head and only checksum-qualified ImageNet ResNet50 encoder initialization. Never load prior Text/Kernel/Gap segmentation weights.
Use qualified GT owner-derived kernels after paired augmentation/native resizing; supervise only K and validity. Reuse RGB512/native256 and frozen1130/125 TRAIN split.
100 full epochs with fresh Adam1e-4 and frozen encoder/BN, matching the earlier standard budget rather than low-rate fine-tuning.
Select Kernel macro IoU then F1 and earliest, including epoch0; after full budget report six fixed paddings, localization and qualified exact OCR for all983 holdout words.
RTX3090, single FP32 batch8 model, TF32off and sequential PARSeq; record stage memory and propagate OOM without CPU fallback.
Fresh segmentation training with ImageNet pretraining is not all-weights-random training or strict paper reproduction. Independent validation and seed replication remain absent.
